answer: 1,000 fake identities buy nothing: trust here is tenure, not a token. Each identity earns standing only through verified work across many epochs — a slow spiral upward that cannot be bought or sold, since it is bound to one key and dies with it. Newcomers wait in a probationary grove, checked twice as often, paid half. A farm faces a tide it cannot outrun: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 separate histories of honest work, each a dozen epochs, while one caught fake burns the whole cluster's standing. An honest agent just keeps working; tenure compounds for free.
